user_confirm.title: Connect to AmpliPi
user_confirm.description: Enter the address of your AmpliPi controller.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the AmpliPi controller, for example amplipi.local.
data_description.port: Port the AmpliPi web app and API are served on, usually 80.

init.title: AmpliPi options
init.description: AmpliPi has 4 buses, so at most 4 things can play at once. RCA Input N can only ever play on bus N.

data.reserved_rca_inputs: Reserve buses for these RCA inputs (other streams only borrow them when every other bus is in use)
data.free_idle_buses: Free a bus once no zone is listening to it
data.idle_grace_seconds: Seconds a bus can sit unlistened before it is freed (changes made outside Home Assistant)
data.mute_on_pause: Mute zones while their stream is paused, so the amplifiers can go into standby
data.mute_delay_seconds: Seconds a stream can sit paused before its zones are muted
data.show_bus_stream_entities: Show bus (Source 1-4) and stream media players

no_free_source.message: {stream} couldn't find a free source: all 4 are in use. Stop something that's playing and try again.

no_free_source_for_media.message: All 4 sources are in use, so there's nowhere to play this. Stop something that's playing and try again.

firmware_too_old.title: AmpliPi firmware is too old
firmware_too_old.description: Your AmpliPi is running version {version}, but this integration needs at least {minimum} to work properly. Update it from {update_url}, then restart Home Assistant.
